summary: Tested the 3 isolated changes from this session: (1) delete-single-career feature, (2) regeneration diversity fix via shown_titles, (3) '25'->'35' text fix on Premium/AiInfoModal/i18n. All 3 work correctly in both backend (pytest) and frontend (Playwright, mobile viewport, logged in as ania_t1@test.pl). Backend: DELETE /api/recommendations/careers/{id} returns 404 for nonexistent id, removes the matching career from now/future and persists (verified via follow-up GET), re-delete of same id correctly 404s again. shown_titles field is present/returned by GET /api/recommendations, capped at 24 entries, and two sequential POST /api/recommendations/generate calls for the same profile produced only 25% title overlap (2/8) - confirms the anti-repetition fix works (must run sequentially; running delete+regen tests in parallel via pytest-xdist on the same user/doc caused false skips/flaky overlap due to shared mutable doc - not a product bug, a test-concurrency artifact, resolved by running with -n0). Frontend: trash icon on each career card opens the confirm modal (career-delete-N -> matches-delete-dialog), Anuluj leaves the list untouched (8 cards), clicking the trash icon does NOT navigate to career detail (URL stayed on '/'), Usuń zawód removes exactly the targeted card (8->7) and persists on next load. Tapping the rest of the card body still navigates correctly to /career/{id} (regression intact). 'Już teraz'/'Z nauką' tab switch still works (8 now / 4 future items). Premium screen (/premium) shows '35' in header perk, perk description, and the usage counter ('Wykorzystano 1 z 35 nowych ścieżek w tym miesiącu') with zero occurrences of '25' on the page; grepped premium.tsx, AiInfoModal.tsx and all 4 i18n files (pl/en/de/nl) - all consistently show 35.

issues: Pre-existing, unrelated to this session's changes: one custom career card for ania_t1@test.pl ('Grafik komputerowy') shows its subtitle in English ('Your own career goal.') while another custom card ('Elektryk'/'Spawacz TIG') correctly shows the Polish text ('Twój własny cel zawodowy.') - looks like a stale/mistranslated custom-career record in seed data rather than a bug in the 3 changes tested here. Flagging for visibility, not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: delete_recommended_career() correctly uses $pull on both now/future arrays in one update and checks modified_count for 404 - clean and atomic.

shown_titles dedupe via list(dict.fromkeys(...))[-RECS_HISTORY_LIMIT:] preserves order and caps at 24 as documented; prompt's avoid_block correctly lists prior titles to steer the LLM away from repeats.
Frontend CareerCard delete icon correctly calls e.stopPropagation() before onDelete() to prevent the outer PressableScale's onPress (navigation) from firing - good defensive pattern.
Text fix for 35 is consistent across premium.tsx, AiInfoModal.tsx and all 4 i18n locale files - no leftover '25' found via grep.
